Name: Stardew Pharmacognosy
Author: Hipperitz
Description:
[b][size=6]Stardew Pharmacognosy[/size][/b]
[b]Medicinal Plants & Preparations[/b]
[b]Author:[/b] Hipperitz
[b]Languages:[/b] Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean
[b]Status:[/b] Beta
[heading][b]Overview[/b][/heading]
Stardew Pharmacognosy is a content expansion mod that adds medicinal crops, plant materials, traditional preparations, and a small laboratory workbench to Stardew Valley.
Grow seven medicinal crops across different seasons, harvest leaves, flowers, roots, or seed capsules, and process them using familiar farm equipment, the kitchen, and the new workbench. The mod also adds wild nettles and new uses for several existing farm products.
An in-game journal records information about the plants, their constituents, historical uses, and related pharmaceutical topics. Sections unlock through harvesting and crafting, but reading the journal is optional and does not restrict production.（Sorry if it was not up to par）
[heading][b]Features[/b][/heading]
· [b]Seven medicinal crops:[/b] Belladonna, foxglove, Datura, black hellebore, opium poppy, sweet wormwood ([i]Artemisia annua[/i]), and autumn crocus ([i]Colchicum autumnale[/i]).
· [b]Different processing routes:[/b] Dried plant materials, traditional preparations, poppy seed oil, and four crude plant extracts. Some crops produce different materials from different plant parts.
· [b]Laboratory workbench and storage:[/b] Manually craft crude extracts and pharmaceutical excipients. The workbench can use ingredients in your inventory or directly adjacent laboratory storage cabinets.
· [b]Additional farm products:[/b] Gather nettles in the wild, obtain whey alongside cheese from supported vanilla milk-processing recipes, and produce starch and lactose excipients.
· [b]In-game journal:[/b] Eight entries with eighteen sections, unlocked by corresponding harvesting and crafting actions. No research points or prerequisite reading are required.
· [b]42 custom regular items[/b], plus two laboratory facilities and one wall decoration. The regular-item count includes seeds, ingredients, and intermediate products; it does not mean 42 medicinal plants.
The mod uses existing Stardew Valley machines where possible. Recipes and processing times are simplified for gameplay.
[heading][b]Screenshots[/b][/heading]
The image gallery shows seasonal crop fields, wild nettle gathering, the cooking interface, the laboratory workbench, and the in-game journal. The images are intended to show actual gameplay rather than a separate simulated interface.
[heading][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/heading]
[b]Required mods:[/b]
· SMAPI — Stardew Modding API (4.5.2+) — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
· Content Patcher (2.9.1+) — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
· Extra Machine Configs — EMC (1.18.0+) — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256
[b]Tested game version:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15.
Install the required frameworks first, then extract the mod archive into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. [b]Keep both included components installed and at matching versions.[/b] Remove older copies or duplicate installations before updating.
Automate is [b]not required[/b]. The laboratory workbench currently supports manual crafting only.
[heading][b]Compatibility & Beta Notes[/b][/heading]
This is a beta version. Selected systems have been tested in-game and automated checks have been run, but not all combinations of equipment, other mods, save states, or interface settings have been verified.
· Multiplayer and split-screen have not been fully tested.
· Third-party modifications to the same machines may affect additional outputs, especially whey from the cheese press.
· Automate compatibility for multi-output machine processing has not been fully verified.
The mod preserves existing custom item IDs where possible, but that does not guarantee every third-party mod combination will work without conflicts.
[heading][b]A Note on the Medicine[/b][/heading]
This mod draws on real medicinal plants and historical pharmaceutical practices. Some featured plants and materials are dangerous. Crafting recipes, consumption interactions, and gameplay effects are simplified fictional representations, [b]not real-world instructions for preparing or using medicines[/b]. Crude extracts are not the same as purified or standardized pharmaceutical products.
[heading][b]A Note from the Author[/b][/heading]
I'm a university student, and this mod is a personal project made in my spare time. My studies take priority, so updates may be irregular and I can't promise a fixed release schedule.
Bug reports, translation corrections, and suggestions are welcome, although I may not always be able to respond or address them quickly.
Thank you for trying the mod!
— [b]Hipperitz[/b]

[b][size=6]星露谷生药志[/size][/b]
[b]药用植物与制剂扩展[/b]
[b]作者：[/b] Hipperitz
[b]支持语言：[/b] 简体中文、英文、日文、韩文
[b]当前状态：[/b] 测试版
[heading][b]模组简介[/b][/heading]
《星露谷生药志》是一款为《星露谷物语》增加药用植物、药材加工品、传统制剂及小型实验设施的内容扩展MOD。
模组加入七种可在不同季节种植的药材作物。玩家可以采收叶片、花朵、根部或蒴果，使用原版机器、厨房及新增实验台加工药材。此外，还增加了野外荨麻采集，以及部分原版农产品的新用途。
模组内附有一本可阅读的生药志，记录植物来源、代表性成分、历史用途及相关药学知识。对应内容会随着采收和制作逐步解锁；阅读完全自愿，不影响配方制作或正常生产。(比较粗糙请谅解）
[heading][b]主要内容[/b][/heading]
· [b]七种药材作物：[/b] 颠茄、洋地黄、曼陀罗、黑嚏根草、药用罂粟、黄花蒿与秋水仙，具有不同的种植季节、采收部位和生长规律。
· [b]不同的加工路线：[/b] 干燥药材、传统制剂、罂粟籽油及四种植物粗提液。部分植物的不同部位可用于不同加工方向。
· [b]实验台与储物柜：[/b] 手动制作粗提液和药学辅料，可读取背包及上下左右直接相邻的专用实验柜中的材料。
· [b]其他农场产物：[/b] 野外采集荨麻；在支持的原版奶类压酪加工中获得乳清副产物；使用农产品或乳清制作淀粉、乳糖等辅料。
· [b]生药志：[/b] 八个条目、十八个独立小节，随对应采收与加工操作解锁，不设研究点或阅读前置。
· [b]42种自定义普通物品[/b]，另有两种实验设施与一件壁画家具。42种包含种子、辅料和中间产物，并非42种药材。
模组尽可能利用原版设施。配方与加工时间均按游戏玩法作了简化。
[heading][b]游戏截图[/b][/heading]
展示图包括四季药材田、野外荨麻采集、厨房制作、实验台与生药志界面，均以实际游戏画面为主。
[heading][b]前置模组与安装[/b][/heading]
[b]必须安装：[/b]
· SMAPI — Stardew Modding API（4.5.2+） — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
· Content Patcher（2.9.1+） — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
· Extra Machine Configs — EMC（1.18.0+） — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256
[b]已测试的游戏版本：[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15。
请先安装上述前置，再将本MOD压缩包解压至游戏的 [i]Mods[/i] 文件夹。[b]下载包中的两个组件均须保留，且版本应一致。[/b] 更新前请移除旧版组件或重复安装的副本。
[b]Automate不是必需前置。[/b] 当前实验台仅支持手动加工。
[heading][b]兼容性与测试版说明[/b][/heading]
当前仍为测试版。部分功能已经过作者实机测试及自动化检查，但尚未覆盖所有设备组合、其他模组、存档状态或界面设置。
· 多人联机及分屏尚未完成全面实机验证。
· 修改同一机器规则的其他MOD可能影响额外产物，尤其是压酪机的乳清副产物。
· Automate对多产物机器的完整处理尚未全面验证。

模组尽可能保留已有自定义物品ID，但不能保证与所有第三方MOD均无冲突。
[heading][b]关于药学内容[/b][/heading]
本MOD参考了现实中的药用植物与历史制剂，其中部分植物及材料具有明显毒性。游戏中的加工配方、食用交互与属性效果均经过抽象简化，[b]不能作为现实制药、药材处理或用药的依据[/b]。植物粗提物也不等同于纯化或标准化药品。
[heading][b]作者说明[/b][/heading]
我目前还是一名在校大学生，这个MOD也是利用课余时间制作的个人项目。由于需要优先兼顾学业，后续更新可能不太规律，无法保证固定的更新周期。
欢迎反馈Bug、翻译问题或提出建议，不过我未必能及时回复或处理。
感谢各位的理解与支持！
—— [b]Hipperitz[/b]
